input: Raw document sentences and given target spans; no target lemma, frame or LU ID.
query: Map each given target to a FrameNet 1.7 frame and all annotated FE layers, including null instantiation types.
offsets: Zero-based Python character offsets, exclusive end, relative to original sentence.
scope: Given-target task, not target discovery. No unannotated-negative inference. No confirmation split.
